description: Design and System-on-Chip (SOC) implementation for signal processing applications. SOC design and testing methodologies. Platform-based design. Intellectual Property (IP) reuse. Built-in self-test. Controlling power consumption in SOC implementations. SOC multi-technology integration of analog and digital electronics, sensors and MEMS.
